about: Carl E. Forsberg is an attorney who represents clients in the Mercer Island, Washington area. Carl Forsberg is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2001 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Carl Forsberg chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Pepperdine University School of Law and graduated in 1983. Carl Forsberg passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1983.
He represents clients with Insurance Coverage issues in Washington. He also represents clients with Civil Litigation: Defense and Personal Injury - General: Defense issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Carl Forsberg has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
